body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "5.5 Graphing Linear Equations and Inequalities", prints these objectives: "Graph linear equations and inequalities in two variables." "Solve applications of linear equations and inequalities.". The section text says: "The rectangular coordinate system is formed by two intersecting number lines, one horizontal and one vertical. The horizontal number line is called the x -axis. The vertical number line is called the y -axis. These axes divide a plane into four regions, called quadrants. The quadrants are identified by Roman numerals, beginning on the upper right and proceeding counterclockwise. See Figure 5.19 ." This card reports that page.
